## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Silla *chànhuǐ* 懺悔 (repentance) liturgy by **Wǒnhyo** 元曉 ([元曉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%85%83%E6%9B%89), 617–686) for the **six sense-faculties** (*liùqíng* 六情 = *liùgēn* 六根: eye, ear, nose, tongue, body, mind). Author signature: *釋元曉撰*.

**Abstract**

The *Liùqíng chànhuǐ* is one of Wǒnhyo's most distinctive ritual-liturgical works and reflects his programmatic integration of *Tathāgatagarbha* doctrine, *Yogācāra* analysis, and *chànhuǐ* practice. The repentance is structured around the six sense-faculties as the locus of *karman*-production; the practitioner takes refuge in the ten-direction Buddhas, contemplates the *bhūtatathatā* of all phenomena, and uses meditative absorption to dissolve karmic accumulations. Together with [KR6k0194](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0194) *Púsà jièběn chífàn yàojì*, it represents Wǒnhyo's contribution to the East Asian Buddhist *practical-ethics* literature; the work is studied as the principal extant Silla *chànhuǐ* manual. Composition belongs to Wǒnhyo's mature productive years.
